meta.title: Implement collection lifecycle PRD proposals
meta.body_summary: Adds automatic lifecycle management for collections to optimize resource usage, including lazy sync, garbage collection, and status tracking.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor implemented lifecycle management; maintainer code review caught memory leaks and design issues, all fixed in follow-up commits before approval.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 5262 changed lines across 24 files, this is a large feature PR by volume, but the majority of changes are in test files (lifecycle tests, electric/query sync tests). The core production changes (collection.ts, electric.ts) are approximately 900 lines, consistent with a medium-sized refactor that merged after iterative review and fixes.

review_details.concern_detail: Cursor bot and Kyle identified memory leaks (collectionsStore not cleaned up, asStoreMap/asStoreArray permanent subscribers), stale preloadPromise, missing stream abort in electric sync, and requested default startSync to false. Kyle also asked for try/catch on cleanup and state transition validation.
review_details.performance_claim: Optimize resource usage by lazily starting sync and garbage collecting idle collections after gcTime.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Lifecycle management required careful state machine design, integration with async sync mechanisms, and proper resource cleanup; agent initial submission had memory leaks and incomplete cleanup that were caught in review.

detection_detail.code_reading: Kyle and bot cursor reviewed implementation, identifying memory leaks, missing stream abort, state transition gaps, and design decisions.
detection_detail.ci_auto: Bundle size report from github-actions showed +1.49 kB for db package, but no performance regression detection.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Unit tests validate lifecycle states and cleanup, but no performance benchmarks or profiler data to confirm resource optimization.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: All identified issues were addressed in follow-up commits before merge.

core_change_summary.description: Introduced lazy sync with startSync option, garbage collection after gcTime, status tracking, preload/cleanup methods. Modified collection.ts, types.ts, electric.ts, query.ts, compiled-query.ts; added lifecycle and error tests.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most line churn from extensive test additions; production changes approx 900 lines.
change_trajectory: Cursor initial commit: implement lifecycle management with sync and GC, added summary doc and debug test.
Background composer: removed summary and debug, added lifecycle tests and changeset.
Iterative fixes: linting, optional startSync, merge main, add back tests, return electric unsubscribe.
Review-driven fixes: added stream abort, state transition validation, error handling, subscriber guard.
Final commits: wrap signal, catch cleanup errors, throw on negative subscriber count, merge main.

review_signals.summary: Flagged stale promise cache and memory leak from collectionsStore not being cleaned.
Noted that asStoreMap and asStoreArray add permanent subscribers without removal, preventing GC.
For cleanup, suggested that electric sync should stop the stream, not just unsubscribe.
review_signals.action_taken: Author added abortController and stream abort logic.

review_signals.summary: Recommended default startSync to false for lazy loading to avoid slowing initial load.
review_signals.action_taken: Changed default to false and updated changeset.

review_signals.summary: Approved with shipit emoji after all fixes.

collaboration_trajectory: Cursor authored initial implementation with lifecycle, GC, and tests.
samwillis pushed iterative fixes for linting, optional config, and merge main.
KyleAMathews provided detailed review feedback focusing on memory leaks, stream abort, defaults, and missing tests.
samwillis addressed all feedback in follow-up commits, adding stream abort, state validation, error handling, and tests.
Kyle approved the PR after all concerns were resolved.
